source_privacy_boundary.source_text: Use Rosetta v3 existing Observation, Frame, Conjecture, Evaluation and Run/Action/ToolCall/Receipt semantics with application namespaced envelopes. Keep CID content identity, stable RID and external XID separate. Akasha consumes immutable source/release/learner events through a local outbox, projects them into declared namespaces, and is rebuildable. #297 owns domain/authority contracts; #299/#300 own release and run/evidence projection; #301 recovery. Store source/effective/observed/recorded times where relevant. A live Falkor service is not a training dependency: compile neighborhoods into a release artifact and enqueue observations locally. Mutation remains with the source/run owners. PRIVATE_REAL data stays outside public worktrees, CI, issue bodies and exports; #327 protects the private pilot. PUBLIC_FIXTURE development continues independently.
